name: Jamaica National Cyber Security Strategy (2015)
owner: Ministry of Science, Energy, Telecommunications and Transport of Jamaica
description: Jamaica National Cyber Security Strategy (January 2015). National cybersecurity strategy of Jamaica developed by MSET with technical support from the Organization of American States (OAS/CICTE), Commonwealth Secretariat, and ITU across technical measures, human resource and capacity building, legal and regulatory reform, and public education.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Ministry of Science, Energy, Telecommunications and Transport of Jamaica (mset.gov.jm) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Ministry of Science, Energy, Telecommunications and Transport of Jamaica (mset.gov.jm).
